seo.description: OEWS Level I–IV wage thresholds for Software Developers (SOC 15-1252.00) in Atlanta-Sandy Springs-Roswell, GA. DHS weighted selection probabilities under the FY2027 final rule.

faq.question: What is the H-1B wage level for Software Developers in Atlanta, GA?
faq.answer: Under the OEWS prevailing wage system, the four wage levels for Software Developers in Atlanta, GA are: Level I $87,859, Level II $109,283, Level III $130,707, and Level IV $152,131. Your H-1B registration wage level is determined by which threshold your guaranteed wage meets or exceeds.

faq.question: What are the H-1B lottery odds for Software Developers in Atlanta, GA?
faq.answer: Under the DHS weighted selection model for FY2027, baseline probabilities are: Level I 15.29% (1 entry), Level II 30.58% (2 entries), Level III 45.87% (3 entries), Level IV 61.16% (4 entries). Actual outcomes depend on total registration volume and wage-level distribution.

faq.question: When is the FY2027 H-1B registration window?
faq.answer: The USCIS FY2027 H-1B cap registration window opens March 4, 2026 (12:00 PM ET) and closes March 19, 2026 (12:00 PM ET).
